items.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
items.text: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management

items.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
items.text: Internal and external stakeholders are understood, and their needs and expectations regarding cybersecurity risk management are understood and considered

items.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
items.text: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity - including privacy and civil liberties obligations - are understood and managed

items.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
items.text: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated

items.heading: Organizational Context (GV.OC)
items.text: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated

items.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
items.text: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

items.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
items.text: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained

items.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
items.text: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes

items.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
items.text: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated

items.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
items.text: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties

items.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
items.text: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated

items.heading: Risk Management Strategy (GV.RM)
items.text: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions

items.heading: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities (GV.RR)
items.text: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving

items.heading: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities (GV.RR)
items.text: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced

items.heading: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities (GV.RR)
items.text: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies

items.heading: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities (GV.RR)
items.text: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices

items.heading: Policy (GV.PO)
items.text: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced

items.heading: Policy (GV.PO)
items.text: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission

items.heading: Oversight (GV.OV)
items.text: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction

items.heading: Oversight (GV.OV)
items.text: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks

items.heading: Oversight (GV.OV)
items.text: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programs, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle

items.heading: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (GV.SC)
items.text: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement

items.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
items.text: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

items.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
items.text: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained

items.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
items.text: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

items.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
items.text: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained

items.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
items.text: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission

items.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
items.text: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained

items.heading: Asset Management (ID.AM)
items.text: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use

items.heading: Risk Assessment (ID.RA)
items.text: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition

items.heading: Improvement (ID.IM)
items.text: Improvements are identified from evaluations

items.heading: Improvement (ID.IM)
items.text: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties

items.heading: Improvement (ID.IM)
items.text: Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes, procedures, and activities

items.heading: Improvement (ID.IM)
items.text: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved

items.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
items.text: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization

items.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
items.text: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions

items.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
items.text: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated

items.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
items.text: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified

items.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
items.text: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties

items.heading: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
items.text: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk
